toolsPreview.name: search_firms
toolsPreview.description: Search the GRC Migrate directory of SOC 2 audit and compliance-readiness firms (facts compiled from public sources). Filter by framework, ecosystem, partner status, or category. Read-only.

toolsPreview.name: get_firm
toolsPreview.description: Get one firm's public directory record by slug. Returns null for unknown or non-public (suppressed) firms.

toolsPreview.name: get_introduction_path
toolsPreview.description: Get the public directory URL and what an introduction to a firm requires. READ-ONLY: returns instructions only — it does not submit a request or create a lead.

toolsPreview.name: list_resources
toolsPreview.description: List GRC Migrate guides, question pages, and blog posts available to read (title, description, url, type). Read-only.

toolsPreview.name: get_resource
toolsPreview.description: Get one guide, question page, or blog post by slug — its title, description, and content (blog body markdown, or the FAQ question/answer pairs for guides and question pages).
